events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch origin and compare T-235 files
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -3; git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main; for f in cloud/src/followups.ts cloud/src/followup-copy.ts cloud/migrations/0024_followups.sql app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts cloud/src/settings.ts cloud/src/reminders.ts; do echo "$f $(git diff --quiet main origin/main -- $f && echo same || echo DIFF) $(git cat-file -e origin/main:$f 2>/dev/null && echo onorigin || echo MISSING)"; done; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show unpushed commits
events.input: $ git log --oneline origin/main..main; git diff --stat origin/main main | tail -5; git log -1 --format='%h %ci' origin/main -- cloud/src/followups.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find probe setup requirements
events.input: $ sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | grep -nE "SIM|CENTRE|PORT|localhost|usage|run" | head; ls app/scripts | grep -iE "nurture|lane" ; ls workshop-plan/ops/*sim* cloud/scripts/*sim* 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find vendor-sim and dev setup
events.input: $ sed -n 20,29p app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs; find . -name "vendor-sim*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head; grep -nE "ADMIN_KEY|SIM|vars|dev" cloud/package.json | head; ls cloud/.dev.vars* 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how others start sim and centre
events.input: $ grep -rn "vendor-sim" --include=*.sh --include=*.md --include=*.mjs app/scripts cloud/scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "wrangler|--var|8960|BASE" | head -8

events.text: Starting a local simulator and centre to re-run the reminders probe; the T-235 code is already on origin.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find sim wiring for local centre
events.input: $ grep -rln "vendor-sim" app/scripts cloud/scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "8792\|_BASE\|SIM" cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/.dev.vars 2>/dev/null | sed 's/=.*/=<redacted>/' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find vendor base URL vars
events.input: $ grep -noE "env\.[A-Z_]*(BASE|URL)[A-Z_]*" cloud/src/reminders.ts cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts cloud/src/followups.ts | sort -u -t: -k3 | head; cut -d= -f1 cloud/.dev.vars | tr '\n' ' '

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find sim base setting in centre

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start simulator and apply local migrations
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && lsof -ti:8882,8960 ; P=/tmp/t235-state; rm -rf $P; mkdir -p $P; (SIM_PORT=8882 SIM_STATE=$P/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > $P/sim.log 2>&1 & echo SIM $!); npx wrangler d1 migrations apply $(grep -m1 database_name wrangler.toml | cut -d'"' -f2) --local --persist-to $P/wr 2>&1 | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find wrangler config and DB name

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply migrations and start local centre
events.input: $ P=/tmp/t235-state; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to $P/wr 2>&1 | grep -cE "✅"; (nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8960 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8882 --persist-to $P/wr > $P/wr.log 2>&1 & echo WR $!); for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8960/ && break; sleep 2; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8960/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "sim %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8882/
